3 · Walkthrough

Things to try

As a visitor

Tap the Gaming PC: its cables light up, the card lists what it sends where. The ports and notes are a lock card. Click a "Follow the signal" chip: the route lights up, narration is locked. Join free on any lock card flips you to Fan Club and leaves you where you were.

As Fan Club

Run "Gameplay to Twitch and YouTube": a pulse runs down each cable, stop by stop. Tap the Shure SM7dB and press Trace from here to see where your voice ends up. Tap the Gaming PC and Pull the plug: TikTok goes down, Twitch and YouTube stay live.

Zoom and find

Click the diagram, then scroll to zoom (it never hijacks page scrolling before you click). Drag to pan, double-click to zoom in, FIT to reset; the minimap appears once you zoom. Type "mic" in Find a device and press Enter. On a touch screen, pinch.

Keyboard, live, motion

Tab into the diagram, then use the arrow keys: they follow the cables to connected devices. Set Stream to Live: cams, mics and lights glow with a tally light. Set Motion to Reduced: pulses become still highlighted paths and zoom jumps.

4 · bt-ui

Kit and build notes

New kit piece: .bt-zoomframe

The pan and zoom viewport: + / − / FIT, a minimap that shows once you zoom, a hint until the first click, wheel zoom only after a click, drag, pinch, double-tap, flyTo and keyboard (+ − 0). Generic, for future maps or a seat plan. It goes into bt-ui.css, shared/ui/zoomframe.js and /dev/ui-kit in every state.

Feature CSS (ts-)

The device drawings, cables, pulse, tally glow, the three looks, the detail card, the stage scenes and the speed gauge. The five signal colors are declared once from kit tokens: video --bt-cycle-2, audio --bt-pink, USB --bt-cycle-7, wireless --bt-lamp (dashed), network --bt-teal. None are purple, so color never suggests "clickable".

Reused, nothing rebuilt

.bt-site-header, .bt-toc, .bt-chapter--ghost, .ai-hero, .ai-stage stage cards with .bt-spotlight, .ai-jr journey, .bt-placard, .bt-lock-card, .bt-chat with BOOMBOT, .bt-view-switch, .bt-chip, .bt-search, .bt-card, .bt-tag, .bt-badge, the beacon, .bt-toast, the mascot. BOOMBOT here is a stand-in drawn with the kit's part classes; the build uses boombotIcon().

Photos and wiring: complete

Every device and every piece of gear has your photo, including the fiber box and the Beacon G6. The wiring is confirmed: Litras and the Key Light Neo on the Streaming PC, the Quest on a Link cable, the Sennheiser set from the Quest to the L-8, each PC's sound into the L-8 (Gaming PC on inputs 3 + 4, Streaming PC on 5 + 6) and the master out split back to both PCs, with no USB link, and the fiber box feeding the Beacon, which feeds both PCs.
